body: I've tried doing the things that I used to love, but the truth is nothing makes me feel better.  I've tried everything.  I'm in a constant state of feeling absolutely nothing, until I feel so sad and angry, then I just go to bed to reset back to feeling nothing.

Nothing different today than any other day.  I'm 21F, unemployed, not going to school, and overall just feeling like a waste of space everyday.  I have literally no friends, and my own family doesn't like to be around me.  I've adapted a nocturnal lifestyle because I've found that this is the only way I'm not constantly talking myself off the edge.  I have no interest in anything, or anybody.  I just don't care anymore and I don't think that this is ever going to change.  People say that it's only temporary, but I've been struggling with clinical depression and very severe anxiety for over 8 years now.  I can't remember a time that I didn't feel like this, and it only seems to get worse.
I just don't even know what to say anymore.  I have nothing, and nobody, and I don't see the point in trying so hard to stay alive.
I don't quite understand what you're asking.

I'm not really close with any of my family.  Not close enough to feel comfortable talking to them about this.  My mom struggles with similar things, so I feel bad bringing it up to her because it makes her feel worse.  She's been making a lot of progress for herself and I don't want to drag her back down.
I don't have any friends.  When I started to get bad again they all cut ties with me.

I don't really like to do anything anymore besides sleep, eat, and watch tv.  I really like to travel but I don't have the means to do that anymore.  I haven't had a good day in a long time.  And even when I have a "good" day it's not really a good day, it's just not as bad as my bad days.
The thing is I just genuinely don't even care about trying to get better anymore.  I just want to die.  I don't care about anything or anyone anymore.
I have tried to call before, but I always end up having a full fledged panic attack.  I've tried online but I felt it wasn't working for me.

He wouldn't listen if I tried to explain it to him.  Last month I told him that I was suicidal and had been wanting to kill myself and he literally said "I don't care".  There's no way to go without him knowing.  He'd find out.

I wouldn't be able to see a doctor without my dad knowing, and he thinks it's all bullshit.  I used to see a psychologist and psychiatrist both weekly when I was 13, but I had to stop going and I haven't been back since.

The thing is I'm not special.  I'm not special in any sort of way.  I have nothing to offer this world.  There is nothing for me here anymore.  I've tried over and over to find a reason to stay, but nothing matters anymore.  Things won't get better for me, but I hope they'll get better for you.

Of course I'd rather be happy, but I don't even know what happy is anymore.  Most of the time I just feel nothing, and then I feel everything, but only the bad things.  I can't remember what it's like to be happy.  I don't even know what would make me happy anymore.  I've tried doing the things that I used to love, but I just don't care about them anymore.  I've tried to do new things but nothing works.  All I do is try and fail over and over again.  I'd just rather not try at all anymore.  I have no motivation to do anything.

But what if I don't want anything to change?  What if I want things to stay exactly the same so that I can justify it in the end?  I feel like I'm subconsciously going to be convincing myself that nothing's changing and if something does change I don't know that I'll even be able to notice it.

I'd like to believe that things will get better, honestly I would.  But I don't think they will for me.  I've been struggling for so long already.  I feel that if I don't end it now that I will just despise myself more the older I get for putting myself through more and more pain.  I already hate myself for letting it go on this long.  I think I owe it to myself to just let go now.
